## Auto-reply to customers after business hours on Telegram

Never miss a customer message again. This template watches your Telegram bot and automatically replies when someone writes outside your business hours.

**Who it's for:** small businesses, freelancers and solo founders who use Telegram to talk to customers but can't reply 24/7.

**How it works:** every incoming message passes through one config step (your hours live in a single node), a Code node checks the current time against your schedule, and if it's after hours the workflow sends your custom auto-reply instantly.

**Setup:** 1) Create a free Telegram bot with @BotFather and add its token to the Telegram credentials. 2) Edit the "Set Business Hours Config" node: opening/closing hour, working days (1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday) and your reply text. 3) Activate the workflow and start your bot - done.

**Note:** Telegram bots can only message people who start the conversation (they tap Start). Ideal for notifications, reminders and existing customers.

Try 2 free automations (this one + appointment reminders): https://zayco3d.gumroad.com/l/muestra-2-automatizaciones-telegram
Want 11 more automations like this one? Full 12-automation pack: https://zayco3d.gumroad.com/l/pack-telegram-n8n

### 1. Telegram Trigger
Listens for every new message sent to your Telegram bot. Add your bot token in the node credentials.

### 2. Set Business Hours Config
All settings in one place: opening hour, closing hour, working days (1 = Monday ... 7 = Sunday) and the auto-reply text. Edit these - no code needed.

### 3. Check Business Hours
Compares the current time (n8n server timezone) with your schedule and flags each message as inside or outside business hours.

### 4. IF After Hours
Routes the flow: messages inside business hours stop here (no reply); after-hours messages continue to the auto-reply.

### 5. Send Auto-Reply
Sends your custom reply text to the customer through your Telegram bot.
